The '''Bug Steak''' is an [[Crafting#Edible Items|edible crafted item]]. The recipe is earned at [[Skills#Combat|Combat]] Level 1.

==Tailoring==
Bug Steak is used in the spool of a [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create {{Name|Goggles|class=inline}}. It can be also used as a red dye color at the dye pots in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Bug Steak is not used in any [[quests]].

==Trivia==
Most food recovers [[health]] using the formula 45% × [[energy]]. Bug Steak, [[Life Elixir]], and the [[Stardrop]] are the only exceptions. Bug Steak restores health of 68% × energy.
